sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Present a routine as short events moving through the day.

items.english: I get up at seven. I have breakfast at eight.

sections.content: Two separate sentences, back to back, do the work a longer "first... then..." construction would do in English. Hungarian is happy to let short, complete statements carry a narrative on their own — you don't need connecting words to make a sequence of events feel like a sequence.
